function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.002 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.003 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.004 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for turns, merging, and intersections. | Texas Transportation Code §545.005 | | **Headlights & Signals** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Turn signals required when turning or changing lanes. | Texas Transportation Code §545.006 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.007 | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing of vehicles requires a valid permit and must follow specific procedures. | Texas Transportation Code §545.008 | | **Commercial Vehicle Rules** | • Commercial drivers must hold a valid CDL.
• Hours‑of‑Service (HOS) regulations apply. | Texas Transportation Code §545.009 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop for school buses with flashing red lights. | Texas Transportation Code §545.010 | | **Traffic Violations & Penalties** | • Points system: 4 points for most violations, 6 for DUI.
• License suspension after 12 points in 12 months. | Texas Transportation Code §545.011 | ### How to Get Official Texts - **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online at the Texas Legislature’s website or through the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT). - **Texas Administrative Code** – For detailed regulations and administrative rules. - **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Provides driver’s handbook, licensing information, and enforcement guidelines. ### Common Resources - **TxDOT Traffic Safety** – https://www.txdot.gov/traffic-safety - **Texas DPS Driver Handbook** – https://www.dps.texas.gov/driverhandbook - **Texas Legislature Online** – https://capitol.texas.gov --- #### Quick Tips for Texas Drivers 1. **Always check for posted speed limits** – they can change at construction zones or school zones. 2. **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on your phone. 3. **Keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement and saves lives. 4. **Know the school bus rules** – stopping for a school bus is mandatory. 5. **Avoid driving under the influence** – the penalties are severe and the risk is high. If you need more specific information—such as how to appeal a ticket, details on commercial driving regulations, or the latest updates to the Texas Transportation Code—just let me know!
